name: vwap_crossover_flow_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index spends 2.5+ minutes (30+ bars at 5s) consistently below session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms accumulate a growing execution deficit versus their benchmark — every fill they get is worse than VWAP. A subsequent crossover back above VWAP accompanied by a 3x+ volume surge fingerprints multiple TWAP/VWAP algos crossing their internal trigger simultaneously, shifting from gradual accumulation to active catch-up. The cross bar closing in the top 25% of its range confirms the absorption is clean with no counter-selling, and these algos' residual order queues drive sustained directional momentum for 30-60 seconds. The inverse holds for downward crosses after price has been persistently above VWAP.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP — no lookback needed, runs from 09:15 open. Not scaled from original because VWAP is inherently session-cumulative regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: consec_below_vwap
indicators.formula: count of consecutive 5s bars where close < vwap, reset on crossover or day boundary
indicators.purpose: Minimum 30 consecutive bars (2.5 min) below VWAP required before a cross is meaningful. Original used 30 min-bars = 30 minutes; here 30 5s-bars = 2.5 min is chosen because on NIFTY, 2.5 min of sustained below-VWAP positioning is enough for institutional VWAP algos to build a meaningful execution deficit without being in fully-regime-trending territory. Lookback window of 360 bars (30 min) ensures the counter has room to reach 60+ bars if needed.

indicators.name: consec_above_vwap
indicators.formula: count of consecutive 5s bars where close > vwap, reset on crossover or day boundary
indicators.purpose: Mirror of consec_below_vwap for bearish crossover detection. Same rationale.

indicators.name: vol_surge
indicators.purpose: Volume relative to 20-minute baseline (240 bars at 5s). Original used SMA(20) on 1-min bars = 20-minute baseline — same absolute time window chosen deliberately, not 12x scaled. A 20-minute rolling average gives a stable intraday volume baseline that accounts for the typical U-shaped intraday volume pattern without being too slow to react to regime changes.

indicators.name: bar_range_position
indicators.purpose: Where the cross bar's close sits within its range. >= 0.75 for bullish confirmation (close in top quarter), <= 0.25 for bearish. Validates that the institutional absorption left no significant tail — a close in the middle of the range suggests balanced supply/demand, not directional conviction.

conditions: VWAP cross up detected (close[i] > vwap[i] AND close[i-1] < vwap[i-1])
consec_below_vwap at prior bar >= 30 (2.5 min of sustained below-VWAP)
vol_surge >= 3.0 (at least 3x 20-min average volume on cross bar)
bar_range_position >= 0.75 (cross bar closes in top 25% of its range)
VIX < 22 (avoid volatile regimes where VWAP algos abandon benchmarks)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four primary conditions must hold simultaneously on the same 5s bar

conditions: VWAP cross down detected (close[i] < vwap[i] AND close[i-1] > vwap[i-1])
consec_above_vwap at prior bar >= 30 (2.5 min of sustained above-VWAP)
vol_surge >= 3.0 (at least 3x 20-min average volume on cross bar)
bar_range_position <= 0.25 (cross bar closes in bottom 25% of its range)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four primary conditions must hold simultaneously on the same 5s bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. A valid VWAP cross on institutional flow should not retrace 8 spot points within 30-60 seconds — that magnitude of reversal (back through VWAP plus 8 pts) would mean the crossover was a fake-out where supply overwhelmed the buying surge. NIFTY typical 30s move is 2-5 option pts; a 4pt adverse move is 1-2x the typical bar noise, giving the trade room to breathe while cutting quickly on failure.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. After a conviction VWAP cross — 2.5+ min of one-sided positioning plus 3x volume surge plus strong range close — NIFTY typically extends 14-25 spot points before the next equilibrium. 7 pts captures the lower end of this range (14 spot pts), giving a 1:1.75 R:R. The target is intentionally conservative because 5s execution means we catch the start of the move, and locking in gains early avoids the pull-back as secondary algos begin fading.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 22 — high volatility regimes cause VWAP algos to abandon VWAP execution in favor of aggressive market orders, breaking the benchmark-chasing mechanism
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST — skip first 15 min (pre-open volatility corrupts VWAP) and last 10 min (EOD flows unrelated to VWAP benchmarking)
filters.volume_filter: vol_surge > 3.0 on cross bar — filters marginal crosses on thin volume that don't represent institutional flow shifts
filters.trend_filter: min 30 consecutive bars on one side of VWAP — distinguishes genuine regime shifts from choppy oscillation around VWAP
filters.spread_filter: N/A — limit order execution at close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VWAP benchmarking is institutional execution infrastructure mandated by performance attribution systems, not an alpha-seeking strategy that gets crowded out

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from the original: (1) UNIVERSE: moved from top-25 Nifty50 stocks to NIFTY index itself — same institutional flow but more liquid, tighter bid-ask, no single-stock event risk. (2) TIMEFRAME: 30 bars at 5s = 2.5 min of sustained below-VWAP (vs 30 bars at 1-min = 30 min in original) — compressed because at 5s we're catching the initial flow shift, not waiting for long regime formation; 2.5 min is enough for NIFTY VWAP algos to accumulate meaningful deficit. (3) HOLD TIME: compressed from 15-60 min to 30-90s — original captured full continuation wave; here we capture just the first impulse as algo queues clear, consistent with 5s execution model. Volume lookback kept at 20-min absolute window (same as original's 20 1-min bars = 20 min). Trailing stop removed — too complex for 30-90s hold; fixed 4pt stop substituted.
weaknesses: Index volume at 5s resolution is synthetically derived and may not accurately reflect true institutional participation
Cross condition at 5s is vulnerable to momentary spikes — NIFTY can touch VWAP and immediately retrace within one 5s bar
Requiring 3x volume AND top-25% range position simultaneously creates very low signal frequency — may fire only 2-3 times per day
VIX filter at 22 excludes high-IV days where VWAP-benchmarked algos continue operating but with wider risk tolerance
